title: Evaluation of a current on a pointwise-bounded test form is bounded by sup|η| times its mass
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, Z ∈ D_n(U) a current on U (GeometricCurrentOn U n), η ∈ D^n(U) a test form (TestFormOn U n), and c ∈ ℝ with c > 0 and covectorEuclideanNorm(η(x)) ≤ c for every x ∈ ℝ^P. If the mass M(Z) = Z.mass (= Z.massOn U) is finite, then |Z(η)| ≤ c · M(Z), where M(Z) is read as the real number M(Z).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (η : TestFormOn U n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ c) → Z.mass ≠ ∞ → |Z η| ≤ c * Z.mass.toReal
